records.title: 使用全局环境的cc 提示/login 使用poe的api发现报错
records.body: 怎么可以不用设置直接使用本地环境的cc啊？
records.author: kakarrot-dev

records.body:
> 在插件设置里面填入环境变量

CC里面配置MAX登录之后能用了，但是在claudian中提示Failed to authenticate. API Error: 403 {"error":{"type":"forbidden","message":"Request not allowed"}}，已经重新登出，登录后还是不行。 CLI路径应该也没问题。

如何解决？是需要重新设置变量？但是这种max登录的 是不是能直接获取到？🤔 @YishenTu
records.author: isjiamu

records.body:
OK，我解决了 https://github.com/YishenTu/claudian/issues/90#issuecomment-3748183460
就是因为代理环境变量的原因，需要在claudian中同样加上
```
•	HTTP_PROXY=...
•	HTTPS_PROXY=...
•	ALL_PROXY=...
```
records.author: isjiamu

records.body:
> 在terminal里claude 已经是登录好并且可使用的。
> 
> 在claudian里一直提示API Error: 403 {"error":{"type":"forbidden","message":"Request not allowed"}} · Please run /login

I ran into the same 403 error. In my case it was caused by proxy environment variables not being inherited when Obsidian launches the plugin.

In my terminal I had HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY set, so claude worked, but Obsidian/Claudian didn’t get those env vars and the request was blocked by the network/gateway, returning 403.

Fix:
	1.	In Claudian settings → Advanced  → Claude CLI path, I manually set it to the exact claude executable that works in my terminal.
	2.	In Claudian settings → Environment → Custom variables, I added the same proxy variables I use in my terminal, e.g.:

	•	HTTP_PROXY=...
	•	HTTPS_PROXY=...
	•	ALL_PROXY=...

After setting both the CLI path and the proxy env vars, the 403 error went away.
